# Enhancement — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 17/34/0 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 107 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (1 member), level 60 (9 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/shaman/enhancement/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD** — 96% of the human spec median (386 vs 401.4 boss DPS over 101 boss fights) [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [enhancement.md](./enhancement.md).

## How the bots play it

## Abilities and when they are learned

The learn level is the first level the bot can have the ability: a trainer, starting, quest or item level from `kit.yaml`, or the talent point in the build above.

| Learn level | Ability | Ranks in the kit | Learned via | Used from |

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **SN00u-quickness — Use Potion of Quickness:** In the full kit (L255): drunk in combat on a boss (target.boss; the page names no pull rule, open question 2).
- **SN00u-merlot — Use Medivh's Merlot:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-rumsey — Use Rumsey Rum Black Label:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-dreamwater — Use Concoction of the Dreamwater:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-arcane-giant — Use Concoction of the Arcane Giant:** HO-TKB-PLAY-341 (druid and shaman consumables, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable a pioneer can realistically get (crafted with a found recipe, a quest reward, or sold) gets a use rule, so the kit generator carries it): Item 47412 Concoction of the Arcane Giant, required level 50, buff spell 36931. Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-emerald-mongoose — Use Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-greater-firepower — Use Elixir of Greater Firepower:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-superior-defense — Use Elixir of Superior Defense:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 253); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **SN00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **SN00u-juju-flurry — Use Juju Flurry:** A haste buff (spell 16322, 60 s item cooldown); the guide names it for this spec; cast on a boss.
- **SN00u-mageblood — Use Mageblood Potion:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-nature-power — Use Elixir of Greater Nature Power:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00u-juju-power — Use Juju Power:** "Starter kit: Elixir of the Mongoose, R.O.I.D.S., Juju Power, Dreamshard Elixir, Elixir of Greater Nature Power, Nordanaar Herbal Tea" (L253); Juju Power beats Elixir of the Giants (L257). Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SN00c-water-breathing-pre-swim — Water Breathing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) every member enters with at least five minutes of Water Breathing: a buff placed for an earlier stretch ran out in the next one.
- **SN00b-water-breathing — Water Breathing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): covered_by [5697, 1066] (v30): a member in Aquatic Form or carrying the other breath buff is skipped. HO-TKB-PLAY-139 (owner, 2026-10-08: the party's shaman or warlock buffs every member before a swim and refreshes it while the party is underwater; druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims): Water Breathing (131, instant, 10 min, 30 yd) on every member, the resident included, who lacks it or has under two minutes left (party_missing with refresh_below_ms, v28), while the party walks or holds at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) or any member is submerged; in combat too, since a buff running out mid-fight underwater is how a member drowns.
- **SN11l-lesser-healing-wave-pressed — Lesser Healing Wave:** Of 2,543 Healing Wave pushes that round 1,236 landed and 322 were interrupted; 461 of the 586 deaths had more than one hostile within 30 yd, and 505 a tick under 35 per cent in their last 30 s.
- **SN11-healing-wave — Healing Wave:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **SN01-lightning-shield — Lightning Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SN00x-rockbiter-weapon — Rockbiter Weapon:** HO-TKB-PLAY-041 (orchestrator, the owner's conformance question, round 63): the shaman guide's first single-target step is "Rockbiter on the weapon" (shaman/leveling.md L108 and L123), the five enhancement shamans of the round all KNOW Rockbiter Weapon (rank 2 at level 8) and the file had no rule for it: the only imbue was Flametongue at level 10, so a level 1 to 9 shaman fought with none, and the three that reach 10 hold a stone or nothing.
- **SN01t-earthbind-totem — Earthbind Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): solo, Earthbind Totem on a runner ("Earthbind Totem to slow a runner", shaman/leveling.md L98, L268), so a mob fleeing at low health does not bring its friends back; the totem pulses a 10 yd slow, so the runner is still inside 10 yd.
- **SN01s-stoneclaw-totem — Stoneclaw Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): solo with two or more mobs on the shaman, Stoneclaw Totem to hold one ("Stoneclaw Totem when you pull more than one mob", "With two: Stoneclaw Totem to hold one, kill the other", shaman/leveling.md L98, L113, L128). The earth slot is empty solo (the party totems SN01a/SN01d need a party); it needs the Earth Totem (5175).
- **SN01b-tremor-totem — Tremor Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Tremor Totem while a member is feared (party.any_feared): "Tremor on fear fights" in the earth slot instead of Strength of Earth, which yields while anyone is feared (restoration.md L125; enhancement.md L163).
- **SN01a-strength-of-earth-totem — Strength of Earth Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): yields the earth slot to Tremor (SN01b) while a member is feared. Strength of Earth is the melee group's earth totem (enhancement.md L163 default melee-group set; leveling.md L167 "Strength of Earth for melee"); party C is a bear, a retribution paladin and this shaman in melee.
- **SN01c-poison-cleansing-totem — Poison Cleansing Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Poison Cleansing Totem while a member carries a poison (party.any_dispellable(4)): "Poison/Disease Cleansing when needed" (restoration.md L126; enhancement.md L163 "add cleansing ... totems as needed"). Deadmines: Poisoned Harpoon, 2-3 a round.
- **SN01d-stoneskin-totem — Stoneskin Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-041 (orchestrator, round 63): Stoneskin Totem (level 4, 30 mana, the Earth Totem item) is known by 4 of the 5 shamans and nothing used it. At the pin it is the melee-damage cut of its aura, -6 per melee hit on everyone within 10 yd for 2 minutes (spell_template 8071 and 8072, durationIndex 4), against the 12 to 20 a level 9 to 10 mob hits for: a third off every blow for the price of one global and a tenth of the pool.
- **SN01e-windfury-totem — Windfury Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-095 (orchestrator rank 1): Windfury Totem in a PARTY from level 32, the air totem (slot 4, spell 8512, 115 mana, needs the Air Totem item 5178, granted at the totem quests): the guide's 'Windfury Totem with 2+ melee DPS, and tell them they tank what they rip' (shaman/leveling.md L192). The vocabulary has no count of melee members, so it is any party; alone the shaman keeps its own Windfury Weapon (a totem alone buffs nobody else).
- **SN02-bloodlust — Bloodlust:** Turtle content: an Enhancement talent (266) at 40 that DependsOn Elemental Weapons 3/3, free, 300 s categoryRecoveryTime, 30 s of haste and attack power. HO-TKB-PLAY-009 (decision 60, SHA-02): `aura_target(8050)` dropped with SN08-flame-shock, which is removed: without SN08 the old guard was never true.
- **SN01f-mana-spring-totem — Mana Spring Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): Mana Spring Totem in the water slot when the party has a caster who spends mana (party.caster_count >= 1, v43; HO-TKB-PLAY-244 proposal P244-3): "Strength of Earth, Windfury, Flametongue, Mana Spring" is the melee-group set (enhancement.md L163) and Mana Spring is in the caster group set too (index.md L85). Not over a Poison Cleansing Totem that is wanted (the same any_dispellable(4) test SN01c uses).
- **SN01g-flametongue-totem — Flametongue Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): Flametongue Totem in the fire slot, in place of Searing (SN09b waits), with two or more melee in the group (party.melee_count, v43; HO-TKB-PLAY-244 proposal P244-3): the melee-group default set (enhancement.md L163, index.md L84).
- **SN04c-tremor-totem-halgan — Tremor Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-187 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator; amp-6's Dragonmaw strategy item 1): Halgan Redbrand (62069) casts ONE Psychic Scream, a fear, when his health first falls to 50 per cent (boss_halgan_redbrand.cpp L54-L58 at the pin: `!m_bUsedPsychicScream and GetHealthPercent() <= 50`, cast on his victim). The old Tremor Totem rule waits for `party.any_feared`, i.e. until the fear has landed; Tremor Totem pulses every 3 seconds and breaks a fear in progress, so a totem already down when he screams ends it at once.
- **SN04b-grounding-totem-zevrim — Grounding Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-187 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator): the dungeon guide for Dire Maul says of Zevrim Thornhoof: "Shaman: re-drop Grounding Totem immediately after it is consumed, and pre-place it" ([dire-maul.md](../../instances/dire-maul.md), the Zevrim line). His Sacrifice (22651) is a 1 s cast on a random member; a Grounding Totem eats one spell aimed at the party, so it is the cheap answer to a landed Sacrifice (a teleport, an 8 s stun and a 300 per second leech).
- **SN04-grounding-totem — Grounding Totem:** Free, 20 s recoveryTime, an air totem that eats one spell aimed at the party. One of the four totems in this workstream with a cooldown to gate on.
- **SN05-earth-shock-caster-t1 — Earth Shock:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **SN05-earth-shock-caster-t2 — Earth Shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of SN05-earth-shock-caster, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **SN05-earth-shock-caster-t3 — Earth Shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of SN05-earth-shock-caster, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **SN05-earth-shock — Earth Shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Earth Shock only to interrupt a caster or finish a fleeing mob" (shaman/leveling.md L110). The interrupt: 30 mana, instant, 20 yd, and its second effect is SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST.
- **SN05-earth-shock-caster — Earth Shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): also on a runner (target.fleeing): "Earth Shock only to interrupt a caster or finish a fleeing mob" (shaman/leveling.md L110). The interrupt: 30 mana, instant, 20 yd, and its second effect is SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST.
- **SN05p-purge-targeted — Purge:** HO-TKB-PLAY-185 (PIONEER FIX, owner ruling recorded as decision 214: "of course an enhancer can purge, it requires a boss or mob rotation to do it, they should just not randomly purge"): Purge only on the listed buffs of the listed mobs, never generic. Source: amp-5's purge-worthy list (study PG, 2026-10-16, from the world DB, spell_template and the core scripts): each buff is dispel type magic and is NOT recast at once by its mob (spawn, out-of-combat and on-aggro buffs stay stripped; the repeating ones have a 15-60 s recast).
- **SN05f-frost-shock — Frost Shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-303 (leveller rotation pass, owner order 2026-10-18): a Clearcasting (45542, from Turtle Elemental Focus 45541, taken at 44 in the levelling build) makes the next spell free, so the refresh waits for no mana: "Refresh Frost Shock when it drops (cheap with Clearcasting)" (leveling.md L205, L264). HO-TKB-PLAY-189 (HO-188): not on Noxxion (13282, Razorfen Downs boss), whose creature_template school_immune_mask is 16 = frost `db:penqle_world.creature_template@tkbplay-189`; a stopgap until p1-loop's target.school_immune(k) (v40) lands, then it is replaced by the vocabulary term.
- **SN07-lightning-strike — Lightning Strike:** `mana_pct >= 12` is the level-free form of that cost for the reason SN06 gives (the pool is never smaller than base). No `aura_self(324)` guard is written for it because it could never change a decision: SN01 re-lays the shield at priority 10 whenever 40 mana is there, and below 40 mana this rule is already false on `mana_pct >= 12`.
- **SN05b-earth-shock-damage — Earth Shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-303 (leveller rotation pass, owner ruling on decision D1, 2026-10-18): no damage Earth Shock for a lone shaman at levels 10-43, as the levelling guide says: "Earth Shock only for interrupts and kills" at 10-19 (leveling.md L125), "No shocks for damage" at 20-29 (L148), "Earth Shock if the mob is about to die or you have spare mana" at 30-43 (L179, L258). The shock stays from level 44 up and below 10 (HO-TKB-PLAY-040, as the owner kept it); interrupts and the fleeing finisher are SN05 at priority 47-51 at every level.
- **SN05d-earth-shock-loop — Earth Shock:** The damage Earth Shock in a party; interrupts stay at 47-51.
- **SN09a-fire-nova-totem — Fire Nova Totem:** The archive's Enhancement area list opens at four targets with "Run in, drop Fire Nova Totem, then Magma Totem", and gives the same order for Elemental; four is its stated aoe_threshold for both. At the pin it is a trainer totem from level 12, 95 mana on a 15 s category cooldown, whose single effect summons the totem (effect 87).
- **SN09b-searing-totem — Searing Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): Searing Totem is the fire totem of a lone shaman or a caster group; with two or more melee the fire totem is Flametongue (SN01g): index.md L84-L88. "Searing Totem when you fight in one spot" (shaman/leveling.md L98); Flametongue Totem replaces it in a melee group only from 28 (enhancement.md L139).

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **SN00u-quickness:** In the full kit (L255): drunk in combat on a boss (target.boss; the page names no pull rule, open question 2).
- **SN05b-earth-shock-damage:** Of the 30-43 exception only "about to die" is written (target.ttd_ms < 4000, v8; the 4 s is mine, the guide gives no figure); "spare mana" has no number and no term, so it is not written.
